answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose commitments bind their rate-limit credential. Within an epoch, a repeated nullifier on distinct messages exposes Shamir shares; enough shares reconstruct the credential’s private key, proving equivocation and triggering immediate collateral slashing. The same rule applies across ripple, quill, and gale domains, while zero-knowledge proofs keep compliant messages unlinkable.
